title: Closing Coverage Check for a Home Oxygen Therapy Return — Age of the Last Eligibility Check
content:
# Closing Coverage Check — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** When Home Oxygen Therapy equipment is returned, the record closes on the day the need ended instead of the day of confirmation only when the last eligibility check of the coverage named on the oxygen record is no more than the figure below before the confirmation. The class and the last eligibility check date are read from the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records. Days are calendar days, counted as the later date less the earlier date. When the condition fails, the record closes on the day the return is confirmed.

| Class of the coverage named on the oxygen record | Last eligibility check no more than (days before the confirmation) |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Supplement Plan G | 90 |
| Commercial PPO, Commercial HMO, Medicare Advantage PPO, Medicare Advantage HMO | 30 |
| any other class | 0 (the check is dated on the day of the confirmation) |

## Both sides (hypothetical, confirmation on 12 August)

| Coverage class | Last eligibility check | Days before | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 14 May | 90 | met |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 13 May | 91 | fails |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 13 July | 30 | met |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 12 July | 31 | fails |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 12 August | 0 | met |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 11 August | 1 | fails |
